pokedexEntries.x: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

pokedexEntries.or: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

pokedexEntries.y: It’s hypothesized that it’s monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.

pokedexEntries.as: It’s hypothesized that it’s monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.

pokedexEntries.su: This is Zygarde’s form when it has gathered 50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.

pokedexEntries.mo: It’s thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

pokedexEntries.us: This is Zygarde’s form when about half of its pieces have been assembled. It plays the role of monitoring the ecosystem.

pokedexEntries.um: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

pokedexEntries.za: This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent's chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.
